subject.title: feat(googlechat): opt-in dmThreadMode to thread DM replies

question: Should Google Chat DM threading be exposed as a new `dmThreadMode` account setting, or folded into the existing `replyToMode`/threading contract?
rationale: The PR introduces a new config key for behavior that overlaps existing reply/thread semantics and reopens a path previously disabled for Google Chat API failures, so automation cannot choose the permanent public API safely.

options.title: Use the existing threading API
options.body: Refine or extend `replyToMode` so Google Chat has one documented reply/thread control surface before accepting the behavior.

options.title: Accept `dmThreadMode` separately
options.body: Keep the new key as a separate account option, but require exported types, generated metadata, docs/help, and live Google Chat proof before merge.

options.title: Decline the opt-in for now
options.body: Keep the current DM thread suppression from the prior fix and close or pause this PR until a stronger product case and proof exist.

recommendation.title: Use the existing threading API
recommendation.body: Refine or extend `replyToMode` so Google Chat has one documented reply/thread control surface before accepting the behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He verified and helped land the prior DM thread suppression and earlier Google Chat thread-reply behavior, making him the best routing owner for the API/product choice.
